SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case c
JOIN contact ct
  ON ct.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN account a
  ON a.account_id = c.account_id
JOIN "user" u
  ON u.user_id = ct.portal_user_id
JOIN product p
  ON p.product_id = c.product_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Thomas'
  AND u.last_name  = 'Bailey'
  AND a.name       = 'Initech'
  AND p.name       = 'Docker Enterprise Variant 15'
  AND c.channel    = 'phone'
  AND c.state      IN ('new', 'in_progress');
